So, Frank answered 56 questions correctly. Since he answered 80 questions in total:

\[ \text{Questions Not Answered} = 100 - 80 = 20 \]

The number of questions Frank did not answer is 20. This information does provide an additional useful equation, as it confirms the total number of unanswered questions directly without needing to solve a system involving all variables.

Thus, the total number of questions Frank did not answer is \( \boxed{20} \).
